I3.location: main, p. 1, Abstract (also si1, p. 10, Table S2, row 'nexc (wt.%) 77K; 25 bar')

I4.quote: ABET N2 (m2 g-1) 1780 1970 2050 2090 2100 2180 3030 [...] The apparent surface area, ABET, was determined using the BET equation applied to the N2 and Ar adsorption isotherms.

I5.quote: This study highlights the significant benefits of incorporating activated carbon (AC) into HKUST-1 matrix to reduce its hydrophilic nature while enhancing its hydrogen storage and release capacities.

notes: Primary research article (Chem. Eng. J. 2025), not retracted (record flag false; no retraction statement in PDF); no statement that the H2 data were published before. The hybrids are majority HKUST-1 (a MOF; HK-AC 50 contains 33.3 wt% AC), so I2 rests on the pure commercial activated carbon MSC-30 (Kansai Coke), whose excess H2 uptake (5.8 wt% at 77 K, 25 bar) and BET area (3030 m2 g-1, N2) are reported. Uptake measured volumetrically (HPVA II manometric, Micromeritics) up to 140 bar at 77 K and 160 K; ntot values are computed from measured nexc via Eq. 2.
